verdict.rationale: Round modeling is a fair question for a cap table platform, but the evidence never documents a scenario or pro-forma modeling feature. Nothing shows modeling of dilution, option pool top-ups, SAFE conversion or pro-forma ownership, or sharing a scenario with counsel or investors. The pack only covers read-only API and MCP access to existing cap table data (SAFEs, convertibles, grants, financing history) and formulas for computing current fully diluted percentages. Those are developer building blocks and adjacent capabilities, not the round-modeling capability itself.
